M-AFK-SESSION.Summary: State store for /afk sessions under docs/afk-sessions/<id>/state.json; enforces expiresAt and exit codes (BUDGET_EXHAUSTED / NO_SESSION / SESSION_STOPPED).

M-AFK-JOURNAL.Summary: Append-only writers for decisions.md and deferred.md inside each /afk session directory.

M-AFK-CONFIG.Summary: Resolve and parse grace-afk config by priority ($GRACE_AFK_CONFIG env var, then project-local .grace-afk.json, then ~/.grace/afk.json). Holds Telegram credentials + autoStop caps. Project-local file gitignored.

M-AFK-USAGE.Summary: Read-only consumer of Claude Code's statusline usage cache (five_hour / seven_day / extra_usage). Surfaces budget utilization in grace afk report and grace afk done notifications.

M-AFK-TELEGRAM.Summary: Minimal Telegram Bot API transport (sendMessage + getUpdates) with dependency-injected fetch for tests. No external dependencies.
